description: This file contains test utility functions and type definitions for channel plugin registration and configuration within a larger messaging or communication system. It provides methods to create plugin registry objects, plugin base configurations for different channel types (e.g., MSTeams), and specialized plugins like outbound or binding resolver plugins. It also includes sample templates for common plugin configurations.

methods.name: createTestRegistry
methods.description: Creates a plugin registry object containing a list of channel registrations and other plugin components, optionally initialized with specific channels.

methods.name: createChannelTestPluginBase
methods.description: Generates a basic channel plugin configuration object with specified attributes such as id, label, capabilities, and configuration functions.

methods.name: createMSTeamsTestPluginBase
methods.description: Creates a predefined MSTeams channel plugin configuration with enterprise-supporting metadata and default capabilities.

methods.name: createMSTeamsTestPlugin
methods.description: Constructs a MSTeams plugin instance, optionally customized with additional aliases or outbound adapters.

methods.name: createOutboundTestPlugin
methods.description: Creates a channel plugin with outbound messaging capabilities, including optional messaging adapters and labels.

methods.name: createBindingResolverTestPlugin
methods.description: Generates a plugin configuration that supports binding resolution, with optional custom account ID resolution logic.
